thread: kevin: Quick thread. customers (AcmeHealth + BetaCorp) want dashboards + per-tenant cost + basic error analytics before GA. We need a minimal surface. anya: I suggest a narrow slice: Tenant Summary dashboard, daily cost CSV export, and lightweight LLM-span tagging. No distributed trace stitching. marco: Tracing hooks: add a span at LLM gateway with tags tenant_id, model, route, token_count; sampling 10% default. Tess: Dashboard: prebuilt template with requests/min, p50/p95, error rate, and cost sparkline; filters: tenant, model, last 24h. kevin: Acceptance criteria: 1) Tenant Summary template exists and loads <1.5s, 2) Tracing spans emitted with required tags and visible in traces UI, sampling configurable, 3) Daily per-tenant token CSV and cost estimate exported, accuracy within 5%, 4) Error analytics: top 5 error messages by tenant with link to raw logs, 5) Rollout via feature flag per-tenant. anya: Engineering estimate: platform 2 sprints (2 engs) for spans and billing glue, frontend 1 sprint for dashboard + CSV (1 eng + designer). Risk: billing lag ~2hrs, call out in UX. marco: Prioritization: if only one item this sprint, choose dashboards + cost CSV. Tracing hooks in next sprint. tess: Sales wants cost data for renewals; ops wants spans for debugging. kevin: Decision: sprint A dashboards + cost CSV; sprint B tracing hooks + runbook. Action items: @marco infra ETA and PR plan, @tess dashboard mocks by Wed, @anya draft RFC and GA gates. ops-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/observe-minimum-surface. kevin: GA gates: dashboard availability 99.5%, cost accuracy within 5% daily, no >2x median latency regression for 95% routes when hooks enabled. We'll sync on Wed. :thumbsup:
